items.q: What sizes and models are available?
items.a: The range includes compact, mid-size and tall cabinets. Compare each series and its model dimensions in the product catalogue.

items.q: Can size, material, colour or process be customized?
items.a: Yes. Send your required dimensions, material, colour and process so the factory can confirm the order specification.

items.q: Can you provide samples?
items.a: Yes. Samples can be arranged before a production order.

items.q: Are technical data sheets and test reports available?
items.a: Yes. Request the technical data sheet or available test report for the exact model you are considering.

items.q: Which applications does the range serve?
items.a: Applications include offices, homes, security storage and banks. Select the cabinet construction and access option for the intended use.

items.q: Can additional protective features be discussed?
items.a: Fire-resistance and anti-theft requirements can be discussed for custom orders. Confirm the required construction and documentation for the specific model.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: The minimum order quantity is 20 units.

items.q: Is pricing tiered by quantity?
items.a: Yes. Send your chosen models and quantity for a tiered quotation.

items.q: Does the quotation include packaging, shipping and tax?
items.a: Packaging is included. Shipping and tax are excluded and should be confirmed separately.

items.q: Can long-term cooperation and bulk pricing be discussed?
items.a: Yes. Long-term cooperation pricing and bulk discounts can be discussed for your order.

items.q: Do raw-material or exchange-rate movements affect the quoted price?
items.a: The company states that its quoted price is not adjusted for those movements. Confirm the quotation terms with the sales team before ordering.

items.q: Can samples be shipped?
items.a: Yes. Sample shipment can be arranged with the sales team.

items.q: Are samples charged and refundable?
items.a: Samples are charged and non-refundable.

items.q: What is the normal sample lead time?
items.a: Normal sample lead time is about 30 days.

items.q: Can a custom sample be approved before production?
items.a: Yes. A custom sample can be prepared for your confirmation before mass production.

items.q: Is the approved sample used for the production order?
items.a: Yes. The approved sample is the reference for the agreed production specification.

items.q: What is the normal production lead time?
items.a: Normal production lead time is about 30 days after order confirmation.

items.q: How is bulk-order delivery scheduled?
items.a: The factory plans bulk orders to maintain a stable delivery schedule. Confirm the dispatch date for your order.

items.q: Does peak season change the planned lead time?
items.a: The company plans peak-season production around the normal lead time. Confirm your required delivery date when ordering.

items.q: Is expedited production available?
items.a: Urgent production requests are supported. Contact the team to confirm availability for your model and quantity.

items.q: Can production progress updates be provided?
items.a: Yes. Progress updates can be provided while your order is in production.

items.q: Is there a quality-control process?
items.a: Yes. The company has a quality-control process for production and outgoing inspection.

items.q: Is third-party inspection supported?
items.a: Yes. Third-party inspection can be arranged for your order.

items.q: Are inspection reports available?
items.a: Yes. Outgoing inspection and inspection reports are available.

items.q: How should a product quality issue be raised?
items.a: Contact the team with the model, order details and a description of the issue so it can be discussed.
